title: ImmunoGenius validated on immunohistochemistry panels of 3,000 lymphoid neoplasms
summary: ImmunoGenius was tested on 3,052 pathologically confirmed lymphoid neoplasm cases with immunohistochemistry results from 25 Korean university hospitals. The precision hit rate was 84.5% overall and 95.0% in 984 in-house cases, with errors from atypical profiles, missing markers and overlapping profiles. The data are retrospective and clinical and histological features must also be considered.
ai_technology: ImmunoGenius machine learning expert supporting system for IHC-based diagnosis

evidence.tested: Nationwide retrospective test against previously reported diagnoses.
evidence.unknown: The algorithm is not named in the abstract and prospective use is not tested; full text not reviewed.
